title: Usage Vignettes and Feature Plays — Compile Apr 2028
body:
Purpose: quick consolidated read for PMs and ENG on recurring usage stories (vignettes) that map directly to small-to-medium feature plays. Aim: accelerate 2–6 week experiments and clarify where we should commit dedicated eng cycles vs suggest product config workarounds.

Methodology: pulled ~120 support threads (Mar 1–Apr 2), 18 SRE incident notes, and 6 customer calls. Prioritized by frequency + immediate revenue/retention risk. This is intentionally informal — notes to iterate during triage meeting.

Topline signals (summary):
- Signal A: unpredictable tail latency when customers enable aggressive batching + cache TTLs. Shows up across 3 mid-market customers (real-time chat) and 2 platform customers (async embeddings).
- Signal B: desire for deterministic cost forecasts per-route (not only per-token averages). Finance teams need per-customer/month ceilings.
- Signal C: friction enabling private deployment KMS integrations — several infra teams hit deployment roadblocks with HSM partners.
- Signal D: feature parity ask: function-calling telemetry (who called what, runtime inputs) for audit/compliance.

Representative vignettes (short):
1) "Retail-Chat" — uses hosted streaming, turned on continuous batching to save cost; noticed 400ms spikes tied to KV cache misses. Customer patched by reducing batch window; customer asks for an auto-config suggestion for max_batch_ms by qps distribution.
2) "LegalPlatform" — on private deployment; delayed rollout due to HSM signing failures; asks for a dedicated HSM integration guide + troubleshooting script.
3) "SearchCorp" — embedding pipeline inconsistent cost reporting by route; requires route-level burn rate projections for budget owners.

Compiled feature plays (suggested owner + effort):
- Play 1: Adaptive Batch Suggester (PM + Serving Runtime) — 2 sprints prototype. Auto-suggest max_batch_ms and batch size using observed qps/latency hist. Low-risk -> try with 3 customers. Owner: eng-serving-runtime, PM: Priya.
- Play 2: Route Cost Forecast UI (Product-hosted-api + Console) — 3 sprints. Surface projected monthly spend per route with percentile bands. Owner: product-hosted-api, PM: Luca.
- Play 3: HSM Quickstart & Debug Toolkit (Private Deployments + Docs) — 1 sprint + vendor checklist. Ship a runnable debugging container and a runbook. Owner: private-deployments, Docs: Evan.
- Play 4: Function Call Audit Events (Console + Observability) — 2 sprints. Emit structured audit logs for function/tool calling and link in console. Owner: observability, PM: Asha.

Priority buckets (recommended):
- Immediate (1–2 sprints): Play 3 (HSM), Play 2 (cost forecast) for top 10 customers.
- Near-term (2–6 sprints): Play 1 (batch suggester), Play 4 (audit events).
- Exploratory: further investigation on cache miss patterns and whether model-variant routing can mitigate spikes.

Quick experimental checklist for PM/ENG pairing (for each play):
- Identify 1 pilot customer + 1 internal staging org.
- Draft success metrics: latency p95 reduction, cost delta, customer-reported friction score.
- Lock instrumentation: event names, telemetry fields, and alert thresholds.
- Create rollback plan and permissible config toggles.

Risk flags / unknowns:
- Auto-tuning batcher might interact badly with dedicated capacity autoscaling -> SRE signoff required.
- HSM vendors differ; one-size runbook may still need vendor-specific notes.
- Cost forecast accuracy depends on model mix prediction; add conservative margins.

Open questions for triage meeting:
- Which 3 customers do we nominate as pilots (ops/AM input needed)?
- Do we treat route cost forecast as a chargeable add-on or core hosted feature? (rev implications)
- Is there appetite to prioritize function-call audits ahead of longer-term observability roadmap items?

Notes to self / internal TODOs:
- Attach sample telemetry snippet from SearchCorp (ticket CSREQ-1987) into Confluence playbook (link above).
- Ask runtime team for histogram export for last 30 days (p95/p99) for two affected customers.
- Schedule 30-min sync with sales/AM for pilot onboarding checklist.

Appendix (short links):
- CSREQ-1987: embedding cost variance (support ticket)
- ENG-5543: KV-cache miss investigation (runbook PR in progress)
- Confluence: internal playbook draft (page id in linked_artifacts)

End — informal; will update after triage meeting. Questions? ping me in #cs-product-ops or drop a comment on the Confluence page.
